# Schedule commands

## brp schedule list

List the app's Bevy schedules

```text
List the app's Bevy schedules

Usage: bevy_copilot brp schedule list [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --host <HOST>        Host of the BRP HTTP endpoint (env BEVY_BRP_HOST, default 127.0.0.1)
      --port <PORT>        Port of the BRP HTTP endpoint (env BEVY_BRP_PORT, default 15702)
      --compact <COMPACT>  Compact (single-line) JSON output instead of pretty: true|false [possible values: true, false]
  -h, --help               Print help
```

MCP peer: `brp_schedule_list`

## brp schedule graph

Fetch a schedule's system graph as structured system-graph data

```text
Fetch a schedule's system graph as structured system-graph data

Usage: bevy_copilot brp schedule graph [OPTIONS] <SCHEDULE_LABEL>

Arguments:
  <SCHEDULE_LABEL>  Schedule label to graph, e.g. `Update`

Options:
      --host <HOST>        Host of the BRP HTTP endpoint (env BEVY_BRP_HOST, default 127.0.0.1)
      --port <PORT>        Port of the BRP HTTP endpoint (env BEVY_BRP_PORT, default 15702)
      --compact <COMPACT>  Compact (single-line) JSON output instead of pretty: true|false [possible values: true, false]
  -h, --help               Print help
```

MCP peer: `brp_schedule_graph`
